review_ServicerContext: review the ServicerContext class that implements grpc.ServicerContext for gRPC testing with rpc time and deadline support
test_is_active: test the ServicerContext is_active method to check if the underlying RPC call is still active
test_time_remaining: test the ServicerContext time_remaining method to calculate remaining time before the RPC deadline expires
